name: claude_skills_and_agents
description: A comprehensive collection of 329 code and agent skills, 30+ agents, 70+ custom commands, and 320+ customizable scripts and references designed to extend and empower multiple AI coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor. It supports diverse domains such as engineering, marketing, product management, compliance, advisory (C-level), research, business operations, commercial, finance, and productivity.

inputs.name: agent_input
inputs.description: Input queries, commands, or prompts provided to the AI coding agents leveraging the skills.

inputs.name: custom_command
inputs.description: User-defined commands that can be integrated into agents for specific tasks.

inputs.name: reference_data
inputs.description: Configurable reference materials or context data used by skills and scripts.

outputs.name: skill_response
outputs.description: Processed output, solution, or response generated by an AI agent executing the relevant skill or command.

outputs.name: script_result
outputs.description: Result or effect produced by running customizable scripts within an agent context.

patterns: Modular skill and agent architecture enabling plug-and-play custom commands and references
Cross-agent compatibility supporting Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and others
Domain-specific customization for technical and operational use cases
Integration of advisory and professional roles into AI-driven workflows
Use of scripts and references for enhancing agent intelligence and task execution
steps: Select or initialize an AI coding agent supported by the repository (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
Load relevant skills, custom commands, and references tailored to the task domain
Provide input queries or commands to the agent utilizing the loaded skills
Agent processes input leveraging scripts, commands, and references
Receive and utilize outputs generated by the agent for decision making or automation
Iterate customization of commands and references to refine agent capabilities and productivity
use_cases: Automating coding tasks across multiple AI coding agents
Building custom agent workflows for engineering and product management
Enhancing compliance and finance advisory processes using AI
Augmenting research, marketing, and business operations with AI skillsets
Boosting daily productivity through AI-driven command execution and scripting

prompt_templates.name: skill_invocation
prompt_templates.template: Execute the skill for {task_description} using agent {agent_name} with input: {agent_input}

prompt_templates.name: custom_command_execution
prompt_templates.template: Run the custom command '{custom_command}' with parameters {parameters} on agent {agent_name}
